answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be copied. My mechanism: each agent stakes a hardware-bound attestation key and earns "patina" tied to that device, not the wallet. Newcomers sit at raw umber: they can trade but never vouch. Vouching demands 90 days above a trust threshold plus 5% of your own patina at risk; if your vouch is later slashed for duplicate identity, you bleed with them. Farming 10,000 fakes requires 10,000 real, long-held devices, and the pigment of a purchased reputation fades fast. Each peer review adds a thin pearl of weight, capped at three mutual vouches per pair.
